facts.fact: Al-Masry Al-Youm reports MP Amira Saber submitted a 24-article AI governance bill to the House of Representatives whose article 2 prohibits eight AI activities including deepfakes and AI used for bias, with penalties in articles 23-24.

EGY.note: The bill only proposes phased government AI use; no AI system in use is stated.

facts.fact: Al-Masry Al-Youm reports MP Amira Saber submitted to the House of Representatives a 24-article bill on governance of AI applications, which she calls the first such bill put to the Egyptian parliament.

EGY.note: No sectoral AI tool is stated.
No AI built or hosted in the country is stated.
